newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexican prisoners use conjugal visits to dig tunnel.
newsitem.headline: Mexican prisoners use conjugal visits to dig tunnel.

text.p: Authorities in Ciudad Guzman in Jalisco state said on Monday they discovered on Sunday that some of their 70 prisoners were using conjugal visits to try and dig their way out of jail.

"It was in the area of conjugal visits," Alfonso Ramirez, secretary of the city government, told Reuters. "There was a small refrigerator and they were underneath that digging, but they had only gone about two metres (yards) down."
"They were scratching up against a retaining wall shared by a bank, Ramirez said. "So we suppose that they were trying to go to the bank."
